Initial release of jet skill.

- Provides commands to manage Just Easy Tasks (JET) using the jet CLI.
- Supports configuring API keys, workspace, and project context.
- Enables finding, creating, updating, completing, commenting on, linking, referencing, and inspecting tasks and project metadata.
- Recommends using CLI commands with JSON and non-interactive options for agents.
- Details task reference formats and guidance for ambiguous task identifiers.
